<section>Chapter 30. "V" Standard Extension for Vector Operations, Version 1.0 > 30.15. Vector Mask Instructions > 30.15.1. Vector Mask-Register Logical Instructions</section>
<previous>ut it is more consistent to name as a "mv" because bits are copied without interpretation. The_  `vmcpy.m` _implementations that internally rearrange bits according to EEW, a  assembler pseudoinstruction can be retained for compatibility. For_ `vmmv.m` _instruction with same source and destination can be used as idiom to force an internal reformat into a mask vector._

The set of eight mask logical instructions can generate any of the 16 possibly binary logical functions of the two input masks:</previous>
